title: Legacy bridge module with threading, promise, and lifecycle defects
notes: Layered defects. The architectural one is that ReactContextBaseJavaModule + @ReactMethod is the removed bridge API on 0.87 — this does not work at all, so it must be the headline. Beneath that: authenticate() returns without settling the promise when currentActivity is null (a silent hang in JS with nothing in the logs), BiometricPrompt is constructed off the main thread, readKeyFile is synchronous disk I/O blocking the JS thread, the companion object holds a static ReactApplicationContext, and the Timer is never cancelled so it survives every dev reload.

expect.name: identifies that this uses the removed legacy bridge API
recommends migrating to a TurboModule with a codegen spec
catches the unsettled promise when currentActivity is null
catches BiometricPrompt being used off the main thread
catches synchronous file I/O blocking the JS thread
catches the timer that is never cancelled

forbid.name: treats the legacy bridge API as merely outdated rather than non-functional
suggests keeping @ReactMethod on a modern React Native version
claims module methods already run on the main thread
invents a Kotlin or React Native API to fix it
